normal.name: Ambiguous Customer Requirement
normal.description: Clause 4.2 says 'shall be robust'. Nobody will say robust to what.

normal.name: Untestable Acceptance Criterion
normal.description: It is measurable in principle and in no laboratory that exists.

normal.name: Silent Stakeholder
normal.description: The one group that has not reviewed the spec is the one that will reject it.

normal.name: Requirement Creep
normal.description: Two new shalls appeared overnight and nobody owns them.

boss.name: System Requirements Review
boss.description: Forty people, ninety slides, and one unanswered question about the thermal case.

rule.text: No shortcuts: any move that adds Technical Debt has no effect here.

normal.name: Thermal Budget Overrun
normal.description: The heat has to go somewhere and every somewhere is already occupied.

normal.name: Interface Mismatch
normal.description: Two subsystems agree on the connector and on nothing else.

normal.name: Mass Growth
normal.description: Every allocation grew by eight percent. The total grew by thirty.

normal.name: Single-Source Component
normal.description: One supplier, one lead time, one very bad day.

boss.name: Preliminary Design Review
boss.description: The architecture is defensible. Defending it takes eleven hours.

rule.text: Show your working: CRAFT and GRIT rolls take -4 here.

normal.name: Machining Tolerance Escape
normal.description: The bore is 0.3 mm over. The drawing said 0.05. Both parties have opinions.

normal.name: Firmware Bring-Up Stall
normal.description: The board powers on, enumerates nothing, and blames the host.

normal.name: Harness Mis-Pinning
normal.description: Pin 7 and pin 9 have been swapped since the first prototype.

normal.name: Fixture Not Ready
normal.description: The part exists. Nothing can hold it.

boss.name: First Article Inspection
boss.description: Every dimension, every finish, every one of them measured in front of the customer.

rule.text: Hands on the hardware: RIGOR and SYSTEMS rolls take -4 here.

normal.name: Harmonic Coupling
normal.description: At 43 Hz the whole structure agrees to move as one. It should not.

normal.name: Intermittent Bus Fault
normal.description: It fails once every four hours and never while instrumented.

normal.name: Control Loop Instability
normal.description: The gain that worked on the bench oscillates on the vehicle.

normal.name: EMC Emissions Failure
normal.description: Twelve dB over the limit at 140 MHz, from a cable nobody documented.

boss.name: Test Readiness Review
boss.description: You must prove you are ready to be tested. That is two arguments, not one.

rule.text: The queue grows: this review's difficulty rises by 1 each round it survives.

normal.name: Vibration Test Failure
normal.description: Bracket fractured at 11 minutes into a 60 minute profile.

normal.name: Thermal Cycling Drift
normal.description: The calibration holds at 20 C and wanders everywhere else.

normal.name: Documentation Gap
normal.description: The unit passes. The evidence that it passes does not exist yet.

normal.name: Late Regulatory Change
normal.description: The standard was revised in March. You have been building to the 2019 edition.

boss.name: Qualification Test Campaign
boss.description: Everything, at once, to the limits, with the customer watching.

rule.text: Chip damage bounces off: any hit under 8 is reduced to 1.
